nom: Sand and Sky Australian Glow Berries Enzyme Powder Exfoliator

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report fewer breakouts, an instant glow, and one notes the glow drops used alongside it feel non-greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe flaky, rough or cracked skin becoming smoother, hydrated and less flaky after use, though a couple note a slightly drying sensation if overused.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including one describing it as acne-prone and dehydrated) report smoother, brighter, more even-toned skin without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly describe it as gentle and non-irritating, though a few note slight dryness or a burning sensation if the paste is too concentrated or over-scrubbed.
segments.mature: One reviewer reports reduced fine lines and firmer, plumper-feeling skin after two weeks of use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report reduced fine lines, tighter and more plumped-looking skin, and a more youthful appearance after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dehydrated or flaky skin report the powder leaves skin hydrated and smooth rather than dry; a few counter this, noting a drying or tight feeling especially with frequent use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports redness became almost non-existent with consistent use, and another notes it doesn't cause the redness or chemical burns they get from other chemical exfoliants.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle and non-abrasive on compromised or reactive skin, with no reports of irritation from most, though one mentions initial purging-like breakouts before improvement.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of pigmentation, dark spots and discoloration, with some noting a more even skin tone after a few uses.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts, reduced cystic acne, and fading acne scars over time; one dissenting reviewer reports the product itself caused new breakouts (later described by the brand as purging) and one reviewer saw no visible difference at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the product balancing oily skin and leaving a matte, non-greasy glow rather than added shine.

aspects.libelle: Can feel drying or tight if overused

extraits.texte: I used this product about 3-4 times a week but unfortunately I did not see/feel a difference to my skin :pensive:

I love this polish. I use it in the shower after I cleanse and it leaves my skin soft and helps slough away the dead peel-y skin. I have dry, acne prone skin. This also makes my forehead look very smooth after :)

I tried the pink clay mask and it suited my skin and I was looking into this polish for so long. Great that they offered to give a free exfoliator so I bought this without hesitation. My skin is no longer looking dull after using this powder polish. I love the smell too! And the exfoliator was giving me breakouts each time I applied (I used once a week). I thought it didn't suit me, so I messaged Sand & Sky who replied that it was my skin doing purging. Well, I continued to use it, exfoliate twice a week and my skin looks better and better. It feels great too! I noticed my blackheads are getting lesser! Definitely will keep both of these products. I'm eyeing for the glow serum but it has been out of stock for some time, hope they bring it back soon!
